title: 68 Strange Things Happening On Earth That Look Almost Too Incredible To Be Real (New Pics)
desc: You may consider yourself well-read or well-traveled. But no matter how much of the world you see and know of, there will always be something that will blow your mind. The posts from the Strange Earth subreddit prove that. This community has no shortage of the weirdest, most bizarre occurrences that you’re likely learning about for the first time. Here are some of them.

title: Hidden Structures in Clouds May Solve a Longstanding Mystery About Rainfall
desc: It's well known that where there's smoke there's fire, but did you know that where there's rain there's ice? Or so the conventional thinking goes, as atmospheric ice crystals allow raindrops to grow large and heavy enough to fall from cold clouds.  There are also 'warm clouds', which generate much of Earth's rain, especially in the tropics, and influence our global energy balance.  Yet how raindrops form inside these sky-borne marshmallows made of water is one of the biggest puzzles in atmospheric science – and a barrier to precise climate forecasts.  Fortunately, scientists have just taken a significant step toward solving this mystery, revealing the previously invisible structures that breed raindrops in warm clouds.

title: Dissected: How scammers built a fake Zoom call from real videos of PM Wong and other Singapore leaders
desc: Analysis of full footage shared exclusively with CNA found that the scammers used obscure or dated YouTube videos of high-profile figures, alongside other deceptive techniques, to make their fabricated virtual event convincing.
